title: Unisex Cornhole – Cornhole Counts as Cardio Tee
hook: Cornhole counts as cardio: a cornhole shirt for the backyard and tailgate player who lunges like a sprinter for a toss that travels twelve feet, worn to the cookout, the tournament in the driveway and every summer birthday.
art: The print is a 1950s gym-poster illustration of an athlete in a red headband, red shirt, cream shorts and striped knee socks, stretched into a full sprinter's lunge with a checkered bean bag in his raised hand and a sweat drop flying, a slanted wooden cornhole board with a round hole and a patch of mustard grass beneath him. CORNHOLE runs across the top in heavy slab capitals and COUNTS AS CARDIO. closes the line along the bottom.
wear: Wear it to the tailgate, the lake house or any lawn where the boards come out, or give it to the friend who has never once admitted that the walk to retrieve the bags was the only real exercise.
qa: What is the Cornhole Counts as Cardio tee?

It is a unisex cornhole graphic tee from Graphic Tees Co. showing a 1950s athlete in knee socks lunging mid-throw at a wooden board, lettered CORNHOLE COUNTS AS CARDIO. It is printed on a Bella+Canvas 3001 in lightweight 4.2 oz cotton, so it stays comfortable through a long afternoon in the sun.
How do I wash it so the print lasts?

Wash your Cornhole Counts as Cardio tee inside out in cold water and tumble dry low. It is 100% combed ring-spun cotton at 4.2 oz, with some polyester in the heather colors, and the cream, mustard, navy and red inks stay crisp through every tailgate and every wash.
Is it a good gift for a cornhole player?

Yes. At $24.99 from Graphic Tees Co. it suits the backyard host, the tailgate regular or the friend who plays in a league, and it works for summer birthdays and Christmas. The free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess on size.
Can I get it by Christmas?

Order by about December 8 and your Graphic Tees Co. Cornhole Counts as Cardio tee should arrive before Christmas. Each shirt is printed the day you order it, so ship times vary a little by location. Orders over $45 ship free, and your first size exchange is free.
What colors does it come in?

Graphic Tees Co. offers it in Black, Navy, Dark Grey Heather, Heather Forest and Maroon with cream and mustard ink, and in Natural, Ash and Athletic Heather with navy and red ink so every word stays easy to read. Sizes run S through 4XL, 56 options in all.
